title: Return or exchange maritime merchandise
summary: Learn how to return or exchange maritime merchandise, such as maps or vessel stickers, by visiting a Service NSW Centre or mailing the items.
intro: If you'd like to return or exchange maritime merchandise items such as maritime maps or vessel registration numbers/stickers, please visit a Service NSW Centre. Alternatively you can return the merchandise and associated documentation via mail.
what_you_need: the merchandise you wish to return or exchange
a Request for Refund Form (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Complete the Request for Refund Form – PDF (if applicable).
